hypothesis: Standings conflict gating reduces S/A1 high-confidence errors without degrading probability quality or materially reducing useful coverage.

success_criteria.required: pre-registered quantitative thresholds must be filled before real evaluation

failure_criteria.reject_or_redesign_if: no robust OOS improvement, unstable by league/season stage, or complexity cost exceeds benefit

can_be_falsified_by: S/A1 error rate not reduced in strict OOS
effect depends on post-kickoff or post-match data
